name: t9
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War (T9)
exe_note: acts' dump, already flat (file offset == RVA); matches the installed build (checked 2026-09-30 against BlackOpsColdWar.exe)
install_note: install_dir is where decompress pulls the .ff and .fd files out of install_casc; zone-decompress applies each .fd to its .ff (FastFile.T9.cpp)

stream.push_current_note: DB_PushStreamPos (0xc986270) keeps the current block for 9 (memmapped) when 0xa9c5350 returns 0, which it always does on PC (xor al, al; ret): reads 'under 9' are the current block's (xanim's 0x58/0x88/0x90 in the fr_ zones, recorded in block 4)

zone_load.note: DB_LoadXFile (0xa9c55d0) before the assets: header outside the stream, InitStreams, push(4), string table, list aligned 8 (0x1bbbbd0), 0xc9863f0 zeroes the string ids (dead block 2), Load_Stream the list, Load_XAsset each

rva_note: discover (load_stream, file_read, advance, file_string, load_string) and acts' cw.json byte patterns (push, pop, alloc, resolve = DB_ConvertOffsetToPointer, stream_init = DB_InitStreams) agree on every address both give; alloc(n) aligns on n, not a mask
inert_base_note: 0xb82ea20 (terraingfx): stores rdx at [[rcx+0x98]+0x28] then tail-jumps to 0xc2fad30, which ends in `jmp rax` (a callback from a table): emusweep --learn cannot prove it inert statically; it reads nothing from the zone (mp_sm_market/berlin_tunnel faulted on it). The other leaf setters are learned: inert.learned.txt
asm_asset_at_note: a read through a pointer field (GfxImage's mips) as a MARK, which the C++ walker resolves without the block layout (asset@ needs blocks.txt)

zone_header.note: found by disassembly: the asset list pointer's offset + 8; TreyarchZoneFormat.h
